svg.title: Deploy with Terraform
svg.desc: Deployment ownership, not a runtime or network diagram. Protected Blob state and approved private deployment access are supplied separately. The platform Terraform root owns Foundry, model deployments, networking, identities, backing services, private diagnostics, and the optional admin VM. Three separate Terraform roots read platform resources by reviewed IDs and names, each with its own state. The Lab root owns internal Container Apps hosting, its registry and runtime identity, application Cosmos schema, monitoring, and optional alert email delivery. The optional Bastion root owns only the Standard Azure Bastion host, its subnet, and its public IP. The optional agent monitoring root owns an Application Insights resource for metadata-only agent traces. Image builds, agent publication, route verification, recovery, and approved quality checks remain separate release steps. No additional gateway, enterprise landing zone, or production readiness is implied.
svg.text: Separate infrastructure ownership from code releases

g.text: Protected Blob state + approved private deployment access
One state key per root; Entra authentication.
Supplied separately, not created by the roots below.
Foundry account, project, and model deployment
Private network, identities, and backing services
Private monitoring; APIM and the admin VM are optional.
Private Container Apps, registry, and runtime identity
Optional email action group; no recipients by default.
Build images and pin the Lab digest.
Publish agent versions; verify and recover routes.
Run smoke checks and approved quality evaluations.
A successful deployment does not prove answer quality.

svg.text: Each root keeps its own state. Review plans before applying.
